name: @dropugc/discover
stderr:
Usage: sli [options] [command]

slideshow-intel — TikTok slideshow & video research engine, driven by your own
Claude via MCP

Options:
  -V, --version                     output the version number
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]                   one-time setup: register the MCP with Claude
                                    Code and print the next steps
  networks [nets...]                show or change the networks you research on
                                    (this is what decides which sessions you are
                                    asked for)
  skill                             (re)install the /research, /diagnose and
                                    /tasks commands for Claude Code
                                    (~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md)
  doctor [options]                  check Chrome, data dir, TikTok session and
                                    library
  login [options]                   get the daemon's Chrome signed in. With no
                                    --platform it handles every network that is
                                    missing one.
  discover [options] <keywords...>  find slideshow-first accounts for keywords
  analyze [options] <username>      deep read of one account
  track [options] [app]             check your own posting accounts (those of
                                    your DropUGC apps) and send their last 35
                                    days to DropUGC — no Claude needed, fine for
                                    a scheduler
  download [options]                download top slideshows of accounts or
                                    specific post links
  library                           query the local library (no browser)
  runs                              list discovery runs
  enrich [options] <collection>     read the comments of a collection's winners'
                                    posts that still lack them (idempotent; run
                                    again to continue)
  audience [options] <collection>   what the comments say: stats + a short
                                    sample (questions, negatives, requests,
                                    phrases, seeded-looking creators)
  brain [collection]                what the library knows about a collection
                                    (objective, evolved rubric, source yield,
                                    known winners, calibration); no argument →
                                    list collections
  link [options] [token]            link this machine to your DropUGC account so
                                    discovery results sync to the Discover
                                    dashboard
  sync [options] [runId]            (re)send a discovery run from the library to
                                    DropUGC — runs sync automatically when they
                                    finish or are stopped; use this for older
                                    runs or failed syncs
  unlink                            stop syncing to DropUGC
  stop                              stop the running daemon (closes its Chrome;
                                    it starts again on demand)
  autostart [state]                 start the companion when you sign in to your
                                    computer, so it can remind you and write
                                    your week (on by default while reminders are
                                    on)
  remind [options]                  what your Claude has to do today (the daily
                                    reminder from DropUGC); --test shows a
                                    sample notification
  update [options]                  update to the latest @dropugc/discover:
                                    stops the daemon, runs `npm i -g
                                    @dropugc/discover`, tells you how to
                                    reconnect
  phone                             a real phone as a gestu
